summary: Deduped discussion signals: vendor releases (OpenHands, JetBrains, Cursor), major privacy/price alerts (Anthropic, OpenAI), security advices (Google prompt-injection, CPU cache), and operator field reports on cost and malware. | Vendor-threaded roundup: major vendor product launches and policy changes (OpenRouter CSAM screening, Anthropic S‑1, OpenAI partnerships), multiple GHSA advisories hitting MCP and LiteLLM, and operator-facing guidance from AWS, Supabase, and JetBrains. | GitHub OSS snapshot: vendor releases (Vercel agent-browser, Cloudflare agents, Anthropic Claude Code) are high-priority; several high-star OSS agent workspaces and security/observability primitives appear but lack independent social/operator corroboration. | Package-index signals show rising MCP, sandbox, memory, and security primitives plus high-install VS Code agent extensions; vendor releases (Transcend, OpenAI, Vercel, Amazon) and operator-facing VS Code extensions are top priorities.
